1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto autóctono, de hasta 8 m de altura, de tronco fino y corteza gris y lisa, levemente agrietada, con hojas ovaladas, flores blancas tubulares y cápsulas velludas de color castaño que contienen numerosas semillas pequeñas; su madera se utiliza como combustible. (Rubiaceae; Rondeletia portoricensis).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Native shrub, reaching up to 8 m in height, with a slender trunk and grey, smooth bark that is slightly fissured, oval-shaped leaves, white tubular flowers, and brown, hairy capsules containing numerous small seeds; its wood is used as fuel (Rubiaceae; Rondeletia portoricensis).
